title: Fabian Maier receives the Wilhelm Macke Award
summary: Congratulations to Fabian! He received the Wilhelm Macke Award of the Johannes Kepler University Linz for his outstanding Master's thesis.
body: Congratulations to Fabian, who received the Wilhelm Macke Award of the Johannes Kepler University Linz (JKU) for his outstanding Master's thesis. The award is presented by the Wilhelm Macke Stipendienstiftung, and the finalists present their work in a public talk with the audience acting as the jury — Fabian won them over with his talk "Bessere Mikroskope für Quantenforschung" ("Better microscopes for quantum research").
Fabian is a PhD student on our Yb hybrid tweezer-lattice experiment.

title: Bodo Kaiser successfully defended his PhD thesis!
summary: Bodo successfully defended his PhD thesis. He did his doctoral work on the Ryd-Yb tweezer array experiment.
body: Bodo successfully defended his PhD thesis “Nuclear-spin qubits and Rydberg interactions in ytterbium-171” — congratulations, Bodo! As the first PhD student on the Ryd-Yb machine, he set up the experiment from an empty lab: the entire infrastructure, the vacuum chamber, and the design of the magnetic-field coils.

title: Welcome Jeremy!
summary: Jeremy Tanlimco joins our group as a postdoc on the Yb hybrid tweezer-lattice experiment.
body: We are happy to welcome Jeremy Tanlimco, who joins our group as a postdoc on the Yb hybrid tweezer-lattice experiment. Jeremy comes to us from UC Santa Barbara, where he worked in the group of David Weld.
Group celebration with traditional Bavarian food!
